Items.title: Meat House/The Butcher's Block/Wild Cuts/Fresh Chops/Fresh Cuts
Items.description: A butcher's shop where fresh meat is prepared daily, offering a variety of cuts to satisfy even the most discerning customers./Perfect for those who seek quality meats for feasts or everyday meals./A butcher's paradise, delivering the best meat in town./A local butcher who prides themselves on offering fresh cuts of meat every day./For those with an appetite for the finest meats, this butchery is a must-visit.
Items.speaker: Butcher
Items.genericDescription: Produces food products from wild game or livestock.

Items.title: Iron Forge/The Smith's Hammer/Steelworks/The Anvil/The Blacksmith's Shop
Items.description: A forge where weapons, tools, and armor are crafted with precision and skill./The heart of craftsmanship where metal is shaped into powerful weapons./Providing quality smithing services for armor and weapon needs./Where metal meets fire to create the finest armor and weapons./Crafting tools, weapons, and armor with great care and skill for adventurers and townsfolk alike.
Items.speaker: Blacksmith
Items.genericDescription: Crafts weapons and tools from raw ores.

Items.title: The Drunken Dragon/The Silver Tankard/The Thirsty Miner/The Boar's Head/The Mellow Mug
Items.description: A lively tavern that offers drinks and entertainment to travelers and townsfolk./A warm and inviting pub where stories are shared over drinks./The go-to place for locals and travelers seeking refreshment and camaraderie./A place to enjoy hearty food, great drinks, and even better company./Offering a cozy atmosphere with great food and lively spirits.
Items.speaker: Innkeeper
Items.genericDescription: Provides food and drinks to townsfolk and travelers.

Items.title: The Clothier's Corner/Fine Threads/The Stitching Nook/Elegant Weaves/The Tailored Suit
Items.description: A fine establishment that creates clothing and garments for both practical use and high fashion./Offering expertly crafted clothes for all occasions./A tailor who provides the finest and most comfortable outfits./Where clothing is made with precision and care for the most discerning customers./Providing bespoke tailoring for those seeking quality and style.
Items.speaker: Master Tailor
Items.genericDescription: Creates clothing such as tunics, cloaks, and robes.

Items.title: The Waxen Flame/The Scented Light/The Candle Maker/Flame & Glow/The Illuminated Path
Items.description: A small shop that specializes in creating candles of all shapes and scents./A peaceful shop filled with candles to brighten any room with fragrance./Crafting candles for both practical use and decorative appeal./Where wax meets wick to create beautiful, fragrant light./Offering a wide range of candles for every occasion, from scented to decorative.
Items.speaker: Chandler
Items.genericDescription: Produces candles, potions, and herbal items.

Items.title: The Miller's Wheel/The Grain Grinder/The Flour Mill/The Harvest Grind/The Grain & Stone
Items.description: A flour mill that grinds wheat, barley, and other grains to create fine flour for bread, pastries, and other products./The heart of the town's baking and brewing community, providing fresh flour daily./Where grains are ground with care to produce the finest flour for all baking needs./A vital business that supports the creation of bread, cakes, and ale throughout the town./Offering high-quality milling services to ensure the finest grains for food production.
Items.speaker: Miller
